title: Data Entry Administrator
description:
About PulseMediaNL

PulseMediaNL is a forward-thinking digital media company committed to delivering high-quality content, innovative marketing solutions, and exceptional customer experiences. We value accuracy, efficiency, collaboration, and continuous improvement. As our team grows, we are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Data Entry Administrator to support our daily operations by maintaining accurate and reliable data across multiple platforms.

Position Overview

The Data Entry Administrator is responsible for accurately entering, updating, verifying, and maintaining company data while ensuring the highest standards of quality and confidentiality. This role requires excellent attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and the ability to work independently in a remote environment. The successful candidate will help ensure that business records remain complete, accurate, and accessible, contributing directly to operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

  • Accurately enter data into company databases, spreadsheets, and internal management systems.
  • Review and verify information for completeness, accuracy, and consistency before submission.
  • Update existing records with new information while maintaining data integrity.
  • Identify and correct errors, inconsistencies, or duplicate entries.
  • Organize and maintain digital files, records, and documentation.
  • Perform routine data quality checks and audits.
  • Generate reports and summaries as requested by management.
  • Assist with importing and exporting data between various software platforms.
  • Maintain confidential information in accordance with company policies and applicable privacy regulations.
  • Collaborate with internal departments to obtain missing or updated information.
  • Prioritize tasks to meet deadlines while maintaining a high level of accuracy.
  • Support administrative projects and perform additional data-related tasks as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent; an associate's or bachelor's degree is an advantage.
  • Previous experience in data entry, administrative support, or office administration preferred.
  • Excellent typing skills with a high level of accuracy.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing error-free work.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel and Word.
  • Experience using Google Workspace, including Google Sheets and Google Docs.
  • Comfortable learning and using new software and database systems.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Reliable internet connection and a suitable remote work environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with CRM or ERP software.
  • Familiarity with database management systems.
  • Knowledge of data privacy and information security best practices.
  • Experience working remotely in a professional environment.
  • Basic analytical and problem-solving skills.

Key Skills

  • Data entry accuracy
  • Time management
  • Organization
  • Attention to detail
  • Communication
  • Problem-solving
  • Computer literacy
  • Multitasking
  • Confidentiality
  • Team collaboration

What We Offer

  • Fully remote work environment.
  • Competitive salary.
  • Flexible working schedule where applicable.
  • Paid time off and company holidays.
  • Opportunities for professional development and career growth.
  • Supportive and collaborative team culture.
  • Ongoing training and skill development.
  • Performance recognition and advancement opportunities.
  • Access to modern digital collaboration tools.

Success in This Role

The ideal candidate consistently delivers accurate work, meets deadlines, maintains confidentiality, communicates effectively with colleagues, and demonstrates a proactive approach to improving data quality and administrative processes.

Equal Opportunity Employer

PulseMediaNL is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all employees are treated with respect and provided equal opportunities.

If you are a detail-oriented professional who enjoys working with data and thrives in a remote environment, we encourage you to apply and become part of the PulseMediaNL team.

title: Customer Support Specialist
description:
Type: Full time

Salary: Location-dependent (UK: Â£30,000âÂ£35,000 GBP / Canada: CAD $48,000â$57,000) + share options

Location: UK or Canada (Atlantic Time Zone only)

Meet The Guru

Resource Guru is a blissfully simple scheduling tool that helps busy teams stay on track.

We boost efficiency, improve resource utilisation, and increase project profitability - while promoting a healthy work/life balance.

Weâre proud to be one of the leaders in our category, trusted by customers in over 100 countries - including top creative agencies like Publicis, TBWA, Grey, BBH, and M&C Saatchi, as well as household names like NASA, Accenture, CNN, Kraft Heinz, and the NHS. They rely on Resource Guru to manage one of their most valuable assets - their peopleâs time.

Weâre a small, fully remote team based across the UK and Europe. We collaborate mainly via Slack, with occasional meetups to connect, plan, and celebrate. See if this is the right place for you.

â­ï¸ The role

Weâre looking for a Customer Support Specialist to join our team.

As more teams use Resource Guru and as we continue to support larger, more complex customers we want to make sure every customer receives fast, clear, thoughtful and genuinely helpful support.

This role is primarily about helping customers by email, understanding their questions, troubleshooting issues, and making sure they get the best possible experience from Resource Guru.

Youâll work closely with Dana, our Senior Customer Support Specialist, and collaborate with our product and engineering teams when customer questions, bugs or feature requests need to be investigated further. We see Customer Support as a core part of building a great product, so youâll work closely with the rest of the team to help improve Resource Guru, not just answer support tickets.

This is a great role for someone with some experience in SaaS or online customer support who wants to keep developing their technical, communication and customer-facing skills in a friendly, remote-first team.

What Youâll Be Doing

Learning Resource Guru inside out

  • In your first few months, you'll get to know Resource Guru inside out - how customers use the product, what common questions come up, and how to guide people towards the right answer.

Responding to customer questions

  • Help customers with day-to-day support questions, including product usage, account setup, billing enquiries, troubleshooting and general "how do Iâ¦?" queries.
  • Most support is handled by email, though you may occasionally join a phone or video call when that would help resolve something more quickly.

Troubleshooting problems

  • Investigate customer issues carefully and methodically - asking the right follow-up questions, checking account settings, trying to reproduce a problem, looking for browser-related issues, or escalating a bug to engineering with clear notes.

Working with the wider team

  • Work closely with Dana and the wider Resource Guru team to understand customer questions, resolve issues, and make sure useful feedback is shared with Product and Engineering.
  • Help create clear internal reports when customers report bugs or technical issues, and tag/categorise feature feedback so the team understands what customers need.

Improving our help content

  • Help keep the Help Centre useful and up to date - updating existing articles, writing new ones, recording simple walkthroughs, or suggesting improvements when you notice customers asking the same questions repeatedly.

Using our support tools

  • Use tools such as Front, Recurly, Customer.io, HubSpot and other internal systems to manage customer conversations, billing questions and account information. We don't expect you to know all of these already, but you should be comfortable learning new software quickly.

Helping customers feel looked after

  • A big part of this role is making sure customers feel heard, understood and helped. We care about support that is accurate and efficient, but also warm, human and thoughtful.

What Weâre Looking ForEssential experience

  • 1-3 yearsâ experience in online customer support, ideally for a B2B SaaS or similar software company
  • Excellent written and spoken English and the ability to explain things clearly, simply and warmly
  • A calm, patient and empathetic approach to helping customers
  • Good attention to detail, especially when dealing with billing, account or technical questions
  • A practical approach to troubleshooting and problem-solving
  • Confidence learning new software tools and understanding how web-based products work
  • Some familiarity with basic technical concepts such as browsers, cache, cookies, internet connection issues and permissions
  • The ability to work independently in a remote team and manage your time well
  • A collaborative and conscientious attitude and willingness to share useful customer feedback with product, engineering and the wider team
  • Comfort with asynchronous communication and keeping written conversations clear, concise and on track

You donât need to be a developer, but you should be curious about technology and comfortable investigating how things work.

Bonus (not required)

It would be a bonus if you have experience with any of the following:

  • Supporting a SaaS product

OULA HEALTH

Product Manager

Full-Time

About Oula

Oula Health is a venture-backed, midwifery-led maternity and GYN care company building the next generation of women's healthcare. We partner exclusively with major health systems â including Mount Sinai, Stamford Health, and Novant Health â to embed our collaborative OB-GYN and midwifery model directly inside their networks. We're a team of ~100 people at Series B stage, with 4 clinics today and three more opening in 2026.

The Role

At Oula, our product doesn't sit alongside our EHR â it integrates directly into it. Every product and engineering decision has downstream consequences for how our EHRs are configured, and every EHR configuration decision shapes what's possible on the product side. Someone has to hold both at once.

We're looking for a technically-minded Product Manager to own and evolve our core technology stack â including our EHR, patient portal, and care management platform. This role sits at the intersection of product, operations, and health system integration, serving as the internal and external subject matter expert on our EMR and the primary lead for health system EHR integrations.

You'll manage the day-to-day health of our tech stack, partnering closely with both internal teams and external health system stakeholders to ensure our systems run smoothly and our integrations deliver. You can sit with a midwife and understand why a clinical template matters, then turn around and write a bug ticket that engineering can actually action, then build the SOP so the next market launch doesn't require you to be in the room. When things are ambiguous (and they often are), you'll lean in rather than wait for clarity.

What You'll Own

EHR Configuration & Clinical Systems

  • Own day-to-day management of our core tech stack: the EHR, patient portal, and care management platform
  • Own Athena and Epic configuration end to end: clinical templates, order sets, lab configurations, payer connectivity, and access management for clinical and ops staff
  • Lead EHR integration efforts as the internal and external subject matter expert â FHIR/HL7 data exchange, health system IT coordination and committed go-live timelines
  • Own and accelerate Epic integration timelines as we onboard additional health system partners
  • Maintain configuration integrity as new markets launch and care model workflows evolve
  • Partner with our IT team on infrastructure; own the clinical systems layer they don't touch

Product Operations & Launch

  • Own bug intake and prioritization from Market Operations â standardize how Engineering receives, scopes, and resolves issues and communicates status back to the field
  • Build structured launch toolkits and training materials so clinic teams are prepared for new feature rollouts on day one
  • Coordinate end-to-end launches across Product, Engineering, and Operations
  • Identify where AI and automation can reduce manual administrative burden in product operations workflows

Standards & Knowledge Management

  • Build and maintain the clinical systems SOP library so new market setup is repeatable â documented well enough that a new hire can execute without you in the room
  • Develop onboarding materials for clinic managers and clinical staff on EHR workflows and tooling
  • Drive feature parity efforts so patients and clinicians experience a consistent standard of care across markets

Data & Reporting

  • Build and maintain dashboards tracking feature adoption, issue resolution, and rollout health across clinics
  • Develop quarterly reporting for Product, leadership, and health system partners on platform performance
  • Ensure data infrastructure is in place to measure the impact of every feature rollout

What You Bring

  • 3+ years with product operations, technical program management, or PM-adjacent work â ideally at a growth-stage digital health or services company
  • Strong problem-solving instincts and genuine curiosity â you like figuring out how things work and making them work better
  • Ease with ambiguity and a bias toward action; this role requires you to create the playbook, not execute someone else's
  • Demonstrated ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments and drive aggressive timelines â ideally with client-facing or health system-facing experience
  • Ability to speak âmultiple languagesâ â comfort going deep on technical details while communicating clearly to non-technical audiences; you can write a bug ticket, an SOP, and a launch plan that people actually follow; hands-on EHR configuration and integration experience strongly preferred
  • Analytical enough to build a dashboard and identify a pattern, even if you're not a SQL expert

What Success Looks Like

In your first 90 days, you've audited our current Athena configuration, identified gaps, and have a remediation plan. You understand the bug triage process well enough to have improved it. You've met your counterparts at every health system partner and know what's coming for the next Epic integration.

At six months, new market launches have a repeatable systems and product checklist. Clinic teams know what to expect before a feature goes live. Bug resolution time is measurably faster and the field is no longer sending issues into a black hole.

At one year, the SOP library is comprehensive, clinical systems configuration is stable and documented, and you've successfully navigated at least one new health system EHR environment. The product team has a reliable partner and the ops team isn't dependent on any single person for systems knowledge.

Deine Rolle

Deine Mission

  • Du entwickelst neue Features unseres Sanierungs-Management-Systems – KI-assistiert und auf Basis unserer bestehenden Architektur.
  • Du bringst Pull Requests verlässlich zum Release: reviewen, testen, Konflikte lösen und dafür geradestehen, dass nur sauberer, korrekter Code live geht.
  • Du bist die entscheidende Qualitätsinstanz für KI-generierten Code – du erkennst die subtilen Fehler, die eine grüne Pipeline nicht sichtbar macht.
  • Du hältst die Codebase konsistent und wartbar: gemeinsame Muster und ein sauberes Datenmodell statt Wildwuchs.
  • Du verantwortest den Weg von der Idee bis zum Release mit – damit Features schnell und in guter Qualität bei den Nutzern ankommen.


Dein Profil

  • Erfahrung mit Claude Code: Du entwickelst KI-first mit Claude Code (oder vergleichbaren KI-Coding-Agents) und prüfst generierten Code kritisch, statt ihn blind zu übernehmen. Bei uns ist das die Grundlage der Arbeit, kein Bonus.
  • Full-Stack-TypeScript mit echter Tiefe: Du bist im Frontend (React) sattelfest und kannst Backend-Code – APIs, Datenbank-Queries, Services – selbst schreiben und korrigieren. Nur so kannst du ihn wirklich beurteilen statt nur durchwinken. 
  • Urteilsvermögen fürs Merge-Gate: Du liest Pull Requests kritisch, gibst klares, konstruktives Feedback und übernimmst Verantwortung dafür, was released wird. 
  • PostgreSQL & Datenmodellierung: Du verstehst Transaktionen, Indizes, Fremdschlüssel und Migrationen – und behandelst das Schema als langlebigen Contract, nicht als Wegwerfartikel.
  • Sauberes Git-Handwerk: Rebase, Merge-Konflikte, CI-Pipelines und ein Branch-basierter Workflow sind für dich Alltag.
  • Disziplin statt Ego: Du arbeitest mit den bestehenden Mustern des Teams, statt bei jedem PR deine eigene Meinung durchzudrücken.
  • Du wohnst bereits in Hamburg: Diese Stelle ist nicht remote zu besetzen. Du solltest bereits in Hamburg oder im Umland wohnen und bereit sein, mehrmals in der Woche aus unserem Büro in Winterhude zu arbeiten.

title: UVC Partners: Data & AI - Master Thesis / Internship (f/m/x)
description:
About us

UVC Partners is one of Europe’s leading early-stage venture capital firms. With our fourth fund generation of €250 million, we invest in disruptive B2B startups at the seed and Series A stage across Europe. Our focus areas include enterprise software, mobility, and industrial technologies.
Headquartered in Munich and closely integrated with UnternehmerTUM, Europe’s largest entrepreneurship center, we are proud partners to some of Europe’s most ambitious founders – including Flixbus, Isar Aerospace, finn.auto, Proxima Fusion, and Aleph Alpha.

At UVC Partners, we’re driven by a deep passion for entrepreneurship and its power to positively shape society. Environmental and social responsibility are core to our DNA. We hold ourselves to the highest standards in everything we do. As a firm, we continuously reinvent ourselves to stay ahead and best serve our portfolio and investors. We believe in ownership over hierarchy and foster a culture built on collaboration, curiosity, and personal engagement. And while we’re serious about our mission, we also genuinely enjoy working together and building lasting relationships along the way.


Your mission

You will join a specialized team working at the intersection of applied research and venture capital, side by side with investors, AI researchers, and engineers building the backbone of our investment intelligence. This is a hands-on role with real stakes. You will be treated as a full member of the team, expected to take a research question from literature to a working prototype and to present your results to the people who make the investment decisions.


Your profile

  • You are enrolled in a Master’s program in Computer Science, Data Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a similar program at a top university.
  • You bring depth, or the ambition to build it, in at least one relevant toolkit, whether that is graph ML and graph databases (e.g. PyTorch Geometric), LLM tooling, tool use and evaluation, or probabilistic modeling (e.g. PyMC, NumPyro).
  • You write clean, modular Python and have firm machine learning and statistics fundamentals.
  • You are fluent with AI-assisted coding tools and you have judgment about them. You know what they do well, where they quietly fail, and you review everything they produce. You do not ship AI slop.
  • You work independently. You have run a project where you set the direction yourself, and you can point to it.
  • You are fluent in English, including technical language. It is what you will work, write, and present in. German is helpful but not required.

How we work
We are an AI-powered development team. Everyone here codes with AI assistance, and we treat that as a craft. You need to know which parts of a problem to hand over, where these tools fail quietly, and how to review output you did not write.
Agency matters a lot in our team. You get mentorship, context, and access to everyone. You do not get someone assigning you tasks every morning. Take a rough problem statement, come back with an approach, show drafts while they can still change, and flag what is not working. What you bring should outweigh what it costs us to support you.

Potential Research Directions
These are directions we could explore, with scope defined together at the start based on your background and where the work leads.
1. With Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) we would work on a graph-structured database, where people and companies are nodes and the relationships between them are part of the data, and ask what that structure can tell us that a table cannot.
2. With Program-aided Language Models (PAL) we would have the model write a small program for every number it pulls from decks and financial statements, so figures are accurately computed, because that is what makes it safe to point a language model at financial data.
3. And with Bayesian Updating we would keep our recorded understanding of a company moving as new evidence arrives, since the investment process is iterative and a view written down two years ago should not still be the view today. Your thesis could focus on one of these, though as a full-time member of the team you will work across several.

Academic Supervision: The Lead of the Data & AI Team is a PhD candidate at TUM's School of Computation, Information and Technology (CIT) and can supervise CIT masters students directly, so there is no separate supervisor search. However, you are free to choose your own supervisor and candidates from other universities bring their own.


What we offer

  • Network: A desk at the Munich Urban Colab, our main office, with the option of a second one in Garching, plus access to the UnternehmerTUM ecosystem of startups, experts, and investors.
  • Team & Culture: Monthly team lunches, our regular Stammtisch, free sports classes, Makerspace access for your personal projects, and regular team events.
  • Compensation: An attractive salary for the full six months of your master thesis or internship.
  • Ownership: Research that is yours end to end and feeds real fund decisions.
  • Equipment: A MacBook or a Windows laptop, whichever you work best on.
  • AI Tooling: Full access to the AI development stack we use daily, and a team that will teach you to use it properly.
  • Real Data: Proprietary venture data that researchers rarely get access to, with the pipelines to use it productively.

Interested?
Please send a one-page CV, a current transcript, and a link to your GitHub or portfolio. Tell us which of these directions interests you most and why. We look forward to hearing from you!


Diversity is important to us

Diversity enriches our team. We explicitly encourage all qualified individuals to apply, regardless of gender, social and ethnic background, sexual orientation, religion, age, or disability.

title: Product Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
Our Company

"Buying Labs is the leading global partner for sourcing and distributing premium consumer goods!"

We're looking for a Product Engineer (m/f/d) to join our Tech team at Buying Labs ideally based in Hamburg or remotely for the right fit. In this role, you'll combine deep technical skill with strong product thinking to build tools and features using AI that create real value for our users and our business. You'll own features end to end - from scoping and design through development, deployment, and adoption - and use AI to build smarter and faster at every step.

This is a role for builders who care about impact: people who understand both the user perspective and the underlying business processes, who can scope what needs to be built and then make it happen.


Your Mission

  • End-to-End Product Delivery: Own features from concept to production and real users, not just code -ship complete solutions that drive measurable business value. Scope requirements, define technical approaches, and deliver across frontend and backend, with quality built in from the start and verified through appropriate testing.
  • Product Thinking & User Focus: Understand user needs and business processes to identify what should be built and why. Translate product ideas and stakeholder input into shipped experiences that users actually adopt.
  • Building AI into Products: Design and integrate AI-powered features into our platform - not just using coding assistants, but building AI solutions that solve real problems for our users. Identify opportunities where AI can speed up workflows, improve decision-making, or unlock new capabilities.

title: Senior PR Manager (m/w/d) - Freelance
description:
Overview

PR steht vor einem strukturellen Bruch. Vertrauen verschiebt sich, Sichtbarkeit wird neu verteilt, KI wächst exponentiell. Wir bei getpress glauben, dass Reputation in den nächsten zehn Jahren der entscheidende Wettbewerbsvorsprung für Unternehmen wird. Und dass die Agentur, die das ernst nimmt, anders aussehen muss als die Agentur von gestern.

Deshalb bauen wir die PR Company der Zukunft. Outcome-getrieben statt Retainer-Stunden. KI-first statt KI-on-top. Automatisiert, wo es skaliert und menschlich, wo es wirklich zählt. Unser über 40 köpfiges Team aus Journalist*innenund PR-Strateg*innen hat seit 2017 die PR für 450+ der spannendsten Wachstumsunternehmen Europas gesteuert – und hat Hunger auf mehr.

Für Phasen, in denen unser Pipeline-Tempo schneller ist als unsere Teamgröße, bauen wir uns einen festen Pool erfahrener Freelancer*innen auf. Bist du dabei?

Deine Rolle

  • Verstärkung im Team, nicht allein auf Distanz: Du arbeitest gemeinsam mit dem zuständigen PR-Team an einem oder mehreren Mandaten, nicht isoliert für dich allein. Die Kundenkommunikation läuft über das Team, mit dem du regelmäßig im Kontakt stehst und dich austauscht.
  • Klare Ziele, eigenständige Umsetzung: Team und Kunde geben Ziele und die Zielmedienliste vor – wie du deinen Teil einbringst, entscheidest du. Du entwickelst Storys, pitchst Journalist*innen und bringst dich aktiv ins Team ein.
  • Skalierbar für dich: Ein Pilotprojekt ist der Einstieg. Läuft die Zusammenarbeit für beide Seiten gut, begleitest du je nach Bedarf und deiner Kapazität gerne auch weitere Mandate parallel.

Wer du bist

  • Mehrjährige, wirklich eigenständige PR- oder journalistische Erfahrung.
  • Du bringst ein aktives, belastbares Netzwerk zu Journalist*innen mit, keine Kontaktliste aus der Vergangenheit, sondern Redaktionen, mit denen du heute noch sprichst.
  • Du deckst mindestens eine unserer Kern-Verticals ab (z. B. VC, Mobility, Cleantech, HealthTech) und weißt, wie die jeweilige Medienlandschaft tickt.
  • Du bist mit ergebnisbasierter Vergütung vertraut oder offen dafür.
  • Du sprichst Deutsch auf C2-Niveau, kannst auch auf Englisch professionell kommunizieren.

Was dich erwartet

  • Klare Konditionen von Anfang an: Du bekommst einen Rahmenvertrag mit transparenter Umsatzbeteiligung – wir legen Zahlen offen auf den Tisch, nicht erst im dritten Gespräch.
  • Kein Vertrag ohne Mandat: Die Unterschrift des Rahmenvertrags verpflichtet dich zu nichts. Erst wenn wir ein passendes Mandat für dich haben, sprechen wir konkret über Kunde, Ziele und Zielmedien – und du entscheidest, ob es passt.
  • Unkomplizierte Zusammenarbeit: Kein Mikromanagement. Ein Kick-off und danach je nach Bedarf regelmäßigen Austausch mit dem Team – so, wie es für euch beide funktioniert.

Wie gehts weiter?

Wenn du jetzt denkst: „Klingt nach spannend!", dann melde dich bei uns , ganz ohne klassisches Anschreiben. Wir sprechen offen über Themen, Netzwerk und Konditionen, damit für beide Seiten schnell klar ist, ob es passt.

title: Backend Engineer - Data & Orchestration
description:
Who we are

Melotech is revolutionizing media and entertainment. We create art through technology for humans to enjoy. In just 24 months, our work has been heard, watched and loved for over 3 billion minutes worldwide.

Founded by entrepreneur and investor Soheil Mirpour, we are backed by top VCs Cherry Ventures, Speedinvest and GFC, alongside world-class angels from firms such as Spotify, Blackstone and KKR.

What you will do

Everything we ship runs on data, and the systems that collect, move and store that data need an owner. As Backend Engineer - Data & Orchestration, you take a data platform that grew fast and turn it into one system the whole company can rely on. You keep it running, you keep it clean, and you make it simpler every month. This is not a pure ETL or warehouse role: you work across the pipelines and the backend services they depend on. We will walk you through exactly what we are building as you go through the process. On a typical day, your tasks may include:

  • Data collection: keeping our scrapers and platform integrations running across flaky sources, rate limits, anti-bot measures and APIs that change overnight

  • Pipelines and storage: owning our event-driven pipelines end to end, from orchestration (Airflow, Dagster or similar) to databases and warehouses, built to survive failures and to keep costs in check

  • Monitoring and reliability: building the monitoring and alerting (Datadog or similar) that keeps our services and integrations healthy, and the checks on freshness, volume, schema and values that catch a wrong number before anyone downstream notices

  • Backend services: working on the production services and APIs our data flows through, including our JavaScript backends

  • Infrastructure and security: owning CI/CD, infrastructure as code and cloud for our data systems, plus access and secrets: who and what can reach which system, including AI tools

  • Simplification: consolidating what grew fast into one documented system, and removing what is no longer needed

  • Working across the team: explaining what the data can and cannot do to non-technical colleagues, and guiding junior engineers as the team grows

Who you are

We are looking for an engineer who runs what they build, and builds things that keep running. You have operated real production systems in a small, fast-moving company, and people trust you with them.

Typically, your profile will look like this:

  • Experience: 3 to 10 years of hands-on engineering, most of it in small or fast-growing companies where you owned production systems yourself rather than handing them to a platform team

  • Python and backend: advanced Python, including async code and long-running data jobs, and enough backend experience to work on production services and APIs, including basic JavaScript or TypeScript backends

  • Scraping and data acquisition: you have kept unreliable external sources running in production (scrapers, platform APIs, unofficial endpoints) and you know how to handle proxies, rate limits and anti-bot measures; using LLMs to extract data from messy sources is a plus

  • Pipelines and storage: you have designed and run event-driven, fault-tolerant pipelines handling millions of records a day, with Airflow, Dagster or task queues, on databases such as Postgres, ClickHouse, MongoDB or Redshift, and you know what they cost to run

  • Data reliability and monitoring: your systems report their own problems through freshness, volume, schema and value checks, and you use Datadog or an equivalent to keep services and integrations reliable, because a wrong number that nobody noticed is the outcome you design against

  • Infrastructure and security: you are comfortable with Docker, Terraform, CI/CD and cloud, and ideally you have run an access review and set up role-based access and secrets management

  • Ownership and communication: you have owned a messy data setup end to end at a smaller company and left it simpler, documented and maintainable; you explain trade-offs to non-technical colleagues, push back when it matters, and have guided junior engineers or led a small team

  • Engineering fundamentals: you learned to build solid systems before AI coding tools were everywhere, and today you use them to go faster, not to replace that judgment; you ship fast, keep the codebase clean, and take the time to understand the context before you build

  • Pace: you thrive in a fast-paced and performance-oriented environment

What makes this exciting

Our data systems feed everything the company does, and you own them outright. You are not maintaining someone else's legacy: you decide how these systems should work and you make them work that way. You're not a cog in the machine but the captain of your own ship, rewarded for performance and respected for leadership. Flat hierarchies mean that your voice matters, your ideas get implemented, and your impact is immediate.

We pay competitive salaries and make you an owner of the business with equity. We work remotely to give you complete freedom over your life, while meeting regularly around the world for global offsites where we strategize, bond, and push boundaries together.

What the process will look like

We hire on a rolling basis. Earliest starting date is always ASAP.

Once you begin our process, you can progress from start to offer within a week, depending on how quickly you can move through each stage:

  1. Initial interview: 30-minute introductory call - getting to know you

  2. Case interview: 90-minute case discussion - present and debate your skills

  3. Founder interview: 90-minute interview with our CEO - going deep on all topics

  4. Offer, contract signing and onboarding

Note: As we are still in stealth, you will learn more about Melotech as you progress through the stages. By the end of the Founder interview, you will have a full grasp of our business and the details of your role.

Tasks

  • A sharp, thorough eye for detail and the patience to get to the bottom of things.
  • A structured, clear way of documenting bugs so anyone can follow them.
  • The ability to think like a user and to use software "the wrong way" on purpose to find its limits.

  • Linux & Infrastruktur: Verantworte und optimiere die Linux Systemlandschaft sowie die zugehörige Netzwerk- und IT-Infrastruktur.  

  • Open Source: Entwickle bestehende Systeme konsequent weiter und begleite Migrationen von Standardsoftware zu geeigneten Open Source Alternativen.

Senior M&A Associate (w/m/d) - Berlin

Dafür brauchen wir Deine Unterstützung!

Die Arsipa Gruppe ist eine schnell wachsende Unternehmensgruppe im Bereich Health, Safety & Environment, unterstützt von Warburg Pincus. Deine Aufgaben:

  • Steuerung von M&A-Transaktionen

    • Buy-Side-Transaktionen steuerst Du eigenverantwortlich von der ersten Analyse bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss.

    • Markt- und Unternehmensanalysen nutzt Du, um attraktive Akquisitionsmöglichkeiten frühzeitig zu erkennen und zu bewerten.

    • Strategische und wirtschaftliche Potenziale möglicher Akquisitionen beurteilst Du und bereitest fundierte Entscheidungsgrundlagen für das Management vor.

    • Sämtliche am Transaktionsprozess beteiligten internen und externen Stakeholder koordinierst Du eigenständig und stellst einen strukturierten Deal-Prozess sicher.

    • Externe Berater:innen steuerst Du zielgerichtet und sorgst dafür, dass die relevanten Workstreams effizient zusammenlaufen.

    • Transaktionsprozesse behältst Du hinsichtlich Zeitplan, Meilensteinen und relevanter Entscheidungsgrundlagen kontinuierlich im Blick.

title: Director of Enterprise Technology

Multiverse is the upskilling platform for AI and Tech adoption.

But we aren’t stopping there. With a strong operational footprint and 800+ employees, we have ambitious plans to continue scaling. We’re building a world where tech skills unlock people’s potential and output.

Join Multiverse and power our mission to equip the workforce to win in the AI era.

The Opportunity

It's an incredible time to join Multiverse as Director of Enterprise Technology, as we scale from Series E toward IPO. Every stage of that journey raises the bar on what "good" IT looks like: more employees, more auditors, more systems, more scrutiny — and zero tolerance for the operation falling over.

We're looking for a Director of Enterprise Technology to own IT end-to-end: two connected halves of the function, the day-to-day running of IT services across the business, and the delivery of the systems and platform changes that will carry us through IPO and beyond. This is not a "keep the lights on" role split from a "build the future" role — it's one leader accountable for both, because at this stage of growth they have to move in lockstep. You'll be the most senior IT voice in the business, setting the strategy as well as running the operation.

This role needs an AI-native leader. Not someone who bolts AI onto existing ways of working, but someone who sees automation and AI as the engine of the team — the thing that lets a lean function support a scaling business without just adding headcount, and that turns IT from a cost centre into a genuine driver of strategic business outcomes.

The Mission: Multiverse is reshaping the future of workforce development. As we scale headcount, geographies, and compliance obligations on the way to IPO, IT has to go from "good enough for a fast-growing startup" to "resilient, auditable, and scalable for a public company" — without ever compromising the experience our 1,000+ employees get day to day.

The Environment: You'll sit at the centre of a small, high-trust, fully in-house IT function, with full ownership of the IT budget, tooling strategy, and roadmap. You'll represent IT to the exec team and, increasingly, to auditors and the board as we approach IPO. You'll have the autonomy to decide how your team's time and the IT budget are split across your two remits, and the seniority to make the case for more of either when the business needs it.

What You'll Own

This is delivered by your in-house team, so you'll own resourcing, workload, and standards directly rather than through a third party.

2. IT Systems Implementation (building what gets us to IPO)

You'll lead the planning and delivery of the systems and platform changes IT needs to make as we scale — new tooling, integrations, identity and endpoint platform upgrades, automation of manual processes, and the technical controls (access management, audit trails, change management) that a business preparing for IPO is expected to have in place. You'll run these as real projects: scoped, resourced, tested, and rolled out with minimal disruption to BAU.

Leading the function

You'll lead the whole of IT — a small, fully in-house team spanning both remits — balancing workload and investment across BAU and project work, and making the call on trade-offs between "fix it now" and "fix it properly." You'll own the IT budget and roadmap, and be the one accountable when the exec team or board asks how IT is scaling with the business. A big part of the role is making things better across both sides of the house: spotting manual processes that should be automated, building workflows that save time, and continuously improving how IT operates as the business scales. You're not just keeping the lights on — you're making the whole operation more efficient, more auditable, and more scalable.

  • Ship your first systems project and define the roadmap: Take at least one meaningful systems implementation (identity, ITSM, automation platform, or major integration) from scope to live rollout, with documentation and controls a future auditor could follow. And at the same time develop a clear roadmap of future projects that allows IT Ops to enable and power the Business for the future rather than provide drag.

  • Build the team model: Establish how your team's time splits across BAU and project work, and how it's protected for continuous improvement work rather than constantly firefighting. Identify any skills gaps and hire or restructure as appropriate.

  • Lead with AI, not just tolerate it: Set a visible standard for using AI and automation as the default way of working across the team — identifying manual, repeatable processes across the IT Ops estate to eliminate, and freeing capacity for higher-value systems work. But you won’t stop there, as you’ll go on to use it where the thinking is hard, not just where the task is easy — diagnosing complex incidents, forecasting capacity and risk, and shaping how the estate evolves."

You'll be judged not on tickets closed but on whether other leaders see IT Ops as a team that makes their work easier."

How We'll Evaluate You (BAM Framework)

We evaluate and drive performance through Behaviours, Achievement, and Mastery, grounded in our Operating Principles. In this role, that looks like:

We treat internal IT as a product and our employees as its users, not as tickets. If your answer to a repeated problem is to do it faster by hand, this isn't the seat — and it isn't a back-room coding role either.

You'll be the engineer who builds the platform that provisions, supports and secures every Wordsmith employee, end to end. The goal is for the function to get more automated as we grow, not need more people.

The Role

You'll own onboarding, access, devices and offboarding as one connected system, and build the tooling — including coding agent workflows — that removes the manual steps at every stage. You'll be hands-on with the physical side of the job too, in the Edinburgh office.

  • Build a joiner pipeline that reads a new hire from Humaans, creates their identity in Okta, assigns app access by group rule, and triggers zero-touch laptop enrolment in Jamf — no manual steps

  • Self-service by default: within nine months, the top twenty employee IT requests — access, kit, resets, software — are self-served through automation, chat or a vending machine, not a ticket to a person

  • Automated joiner/mover/leaver: within twelve months, role changes and offboarding run automatically from the HRIS, with access removed same-day and hardware recovered

  • Build over buy: you ship internal tooling and coding agent workflows that remove manual steps, so the function scales on automation, not headcount

  • Secure and audit-ready: the fleet stays managed and SOC 2 evidence generates itself, rather than being assembled by hand before an audit

Who you might be

We're not hiring a traditional IT person — we're hiring someone who builds. That might mean you're:

  • a DevOps, SRE or platform engineer who automates infrastructure and wants to point that at people and devices

Bonus:

  • Exposure to identity and device tooling such as Okta, Google Workspace or Jamf

  • Experience with SOC 2 or security compliance

  • Having run or automated onboarding, endpoints or internal tools before

How we work

This role is on-site in Edinburgh, reporting into Security — you'll be hands-on with the actual fleet, not just its dashboards. It's a high-trust environment: you own the systems you build, end to end, with light process and a bias toward shipping.

This isn't a back-room coding role. You own real employee outcomes and the physical office setup alongside the software.

What you can expect

  • Real ownership over the platform that runs every Wordsmith employee, from identity to hardware

  • Freedom to build over buy — you ship the tooling, not just work the tickets

  • We'll teach you the IT and security domain — you bring the instinct to automate

Why Wordsmith

We're growing quickly, and every new hire adds more identity, access and devices to manage. Getting that right — automated, secure and audit-ready — is core to how fast and how safely we can scale as a company.

If you want to build the system that runs an entire company's IT, rather than staff it, this is a strong place to do it.

title: VP Finance

The Role

We are seeking a VP Finance to build the finance function that will support Geordie through its next stage of growth.

Your mission is to build the financial foundation that enables Geordie to scale with confidence. You'll combine rigorous financial management, thoughtful planning and modern systems to give the business the insight, discipline and operational excellence it needs to grow.

Initially, you will be a hands-on individual contributor responsible for building and operating the finance function. You'll own financial planning, reporting, forecasting, cash management and financial operations, while working closely with our external finance partners who manage bookkeeping, VAT and other compliance processes.

This is not a traditional finance role focused solely on reporting historical numbers. We are looking for someone who enjoys building systems, improving processes and helping leadership make better decisions through high-quality financial analysis and insight.

Over time, you'll build an exceptionally efficient finance function that leverages automation and AI wherever practical, allowing the team to scale alongside the business without growing linearly with headcount.

What You'll Do

Financial Leadership

  • Own the finance function end-to-end, initially as Geordie's sole internal finance hire.

  • Build robust financial planning, budgeting and forecasting processes that support rapid company growth.

  • Own the company operating model, including revenue, ARR, hiring plans, cash runway and scenario modelling.

  • Produce clear, high-quality reporting for leadership, the Board and investors.

  • Partner closely with the CEO and leadership team to provide financial analysis that supports strategic decision-making.

Financial Operations

  • Own cash flow management, treasury oversight and working capital.

  • Oversee invoicing, accounts payable and financial operations, working closely with external finance partners.

  • Build scalable quote-to-cash processes alongside RevOps and Legal, ensuring strong financial controls as the business grows.

  • Ensure banking, insurance and core financial infrastructure operate effectively.

  • Own financial compliance across our UK and US entities, including tax requirements, R&D claims and coordination with external advisers.

Business Performance

  • Develop a deep understanding of the company's unit economics, gross margins and customer profitability.

  • Help leadership understand where capital is being deployed most effectively and provide financial insight to support investment decisions.

  • Support commercial teams with financial analysis around customer profitability, pricing, commercial structures and larger customer opportunities.

  • Partner with Product as a finance domain expert, providing input into the evolution of Geordie's cost management capabilities.

Finance Systems & Automation

  • Help build a modern, highly efficient finance function through thoughtful use of AI, automation and best-in-class financial systems.

  • Work closely with our Internal Systems & AI Lead to identify opportunities to automate finance workflows, improve reporting and reduce manual effort.

  • Continuously improve finance systems, processes and controls to increase the leverage of the finance function as the company scales.

Fundraising & Growth

  • Support future fundraising processes through financial modelling, investor reporting and due diligence.

  • Help ensure the business maintains the financial discipline and operational maturity required to scale.

  • Over time, build and lead a lean, high-performing finance team as the complexity of the business grows.

Ideal Background

  • Experience leading finance within a high-growth B2B SaaS or technology company.

  • Strong background in FP&A, strategic finance or commercial finance, with the ability to build robust financial models and planning processes.

  • Comfortable operating as a hands-on individual contributor while building functions from first principles.

  • Experience producing Board and investor reporting and supporting fundraising or due diligence processes.

  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to translate financial data into actionable business insight.

  • Experience improving finance systems, processes and operational workflows.

  • Curious about AI and excited by the opportunity to build a modern, highly automated finance function.

  • Highly proactive, organised and comfortable operating independently in a fast-moving environment.

Why This Role

Finance has an opportunity to change dramatically over the coming decade. We believe AI and automation will fundamentally change how finance teams operate, allowing small teams to deliver far greater leverage than ever before.

At Geordie, we want to build a finance function that embraces that opportunity from day one. Rather than scaling through headcount alone, we want to scale through better systems, better automation and better decision-making.

This role offers the opportunity to build that function from the ground up and, over time, grow it into a world-class finance organisation while helping shape the future of one of the fastest-growing AI security companies.

Our Values

Solve What Matters

We listen intently and stay focused on what truly matters to our customers. If it doesn't help them navigate real-world agentic adoption and risk, it's probably not worth building.

Build, Learn, Iterate

We favour momentum over perfection; testing, learning, and evolving through action. It's how we move fast and get better, together.

Kind, Not Comfortable

We're honest, respectful, and unafraid to challenge each other. We believe doing great work should feel good, too. Kindness makes that possible.

title: Claims Handler – Gadget & Warranty
description:
Turning risk into opportunity

Human progress runs on a single trade: risk for opportunity. Every venture worth doing - a new business, a new home, an exciting trip - means accepting the chance it goes wrong. Insurance is what lets us take those chances anyway, and the claim is the moment it either delivers on that promise or fails to.

We're rebuilding that moment. ClaimSorted is an AI-native claims solution for insurers and large corporates that resolves claims faster, fairer, and more reliably than the industry ever has. Handle risk that well, and people are free to take on more of it - that's how you push society toward opportunity: not by eliminating risk, but by making recovery so fast and certain it stops being a reason to hold back.

We're one of the fastest-growing InsurTechs - scaling 10x YoY, processing hundreds of millions in claims payouts, and backed by the world's leading investors: Y Combinator, Atomico, and Eurazeo.


What we are looking for

We are looking for a confident, analytical and detail-focused QA & Authorisation Handler to join our Technical Claims Support Team.

You will provide a key technical control across our claims operation, completing Quality Assurance reviews and reviewing claim settlements at the authorisation stage.

As the final line of defence before a claim settlement is approved, you will be responsible for independently reviewing the claim, evidence, policy coverage and settlement calculation before making the decision to authorise, pass back or escalate.

This requires confidence and strong technical judgement. You must be comfortable making decisions, challenging claim assessments where something does not look right and clearly explaining the reasoning behind your decision.

The role goes beyond identifying individual errors. You will use findings from QA and authorisations to identify potential financial leakage, recurring handling issues, process and control gaps and emerging trends across the claims operation.

You will be comfortable using data to understand where issues are occurring, identify root causes and turn findings into practical improvements to processes, controls, guidance and training.

As ClaimSorted works across a range of insurance products and partners, you will need to be adaptable and confident moving between different products, policy wordings, processes and priorities while maintaining consistently high standards.

As part of the wider Technical Claims Support Team, you will also support other technical claims activities where required.

Responsibilities

  • Review claim settlements at authorisation stage across all ClaimSorted products, acting as the final line of defence before payment is approved.

  • Independently review policy coverage, supporting evidence and settlement calculations, making confident decisions to authorise, pass back or escalate.

  • Complete Quality Assurance reviews across all products, ensuring claims are handled accurately, fairly and in line with policy, partner and internal requirements.

  • Identify and prevent financial leakage, incorrect settlements and other customer or financial risks.

  • Provide clear, constructive and evidence-based feedback to Claims Handlers, confidently challenging decisions where required.

  • Use QA, authorisation and leakage data across products to identify trends, recurring errors, training needs and process or control gaps.

  • Support improvements to claims processes, guidance and controls based on findings and root-cause analysis.

  • Maintain accurate records of decisions and findings while effectively managing and prioritising QA and authorisation workloads.

  • Build and maintain the technical knowledge required to work confidently across all ClaimSorted product lines, partners and processes.

  • Work collaboratively across Claims Operations and the wider Technical Claims Support Team.

Skills and Experience Required

  • +2 years experience completing claim authorisations within an insurance claims team is essential, with responsibility for reviewing and making decisions on claim settlements.

  • +3 years experience working across two or more of the following product lines within a claims role: Pet, Travel, Property, Auto, Gadget or similar insurance products.

  • Strong technical claims knowledge, with the confidence to independently review, challenge and make evidence-based decisions.

  • Excellent attention to detail, particularly when reviewing policy coverage, supporting evidence and settlement calculations.

  • Strong analytical skills, with experience identifying financial leakage, trends, recurring errors and process or control gaps.

  • Able to confidently provide clear, constructive feedback and explain the rationale behind decisions.

  • Highly organised and able to prioritise a varied workload based on risk, value and urgency.

  • Adaptable and comfortable learning new products, policy wordings and processes in a fast-paced environment.

Mission

To act as a final line of defence within the claims settlement process, ensuring claim outcomes are accurate, fair and supported by policy and evidence before settlement is authorised.

The QA & Authorisation Handler will use strong technical judgement and independent decision-making to protect customer outcomes and financial performance, identifying errors, potential leakage and operational risks before they result in incorrect settlements.

Through Quality Assurance, data analysis and trend identification, the role will also identify wider knowledge, process and control gaps and help turn individual findings into sustainable improvements across Claims Operations

The team is made of Sales, Solutions, Support, Marketing, and Partnership professionals that work together to create valuable solutions that will help bring AI to as many users as possible.

Our Sales team has a unique mission to help customers understand the deep impact that highly capable AI models can bring to their business and users. This role is a mixture of technical understanding, vision, partnership, and value-driven strategy.

You build strong relationships with executives and professionals across functions and serve as a trusted advisor.

description:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.

Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

 

Attributes We Value

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

 

About the role...

As Partnerships Director, France & Spain, you will lead and develop a team of four partnership managers:

  • Two Accounting Partnerships Managers

  • One Venture Capital Partnerships Manager

  • One Travel & E-commerce Partnerships Manager

You will own the partnerships strategy and commercial performance across both markets, building a channel-led growth engine that generates qualified introductions, partner-sourced pipeline and net-new business for Airwallex.

This is a strategic, hands-on player-coach role. You will set direction, develop the team and build the operating model, while personally sourcing, negotiating, activating and growing strategic partnerships.

The role is focused on commercial partnerships and lead generation—not technical integrations. The initial priority is to build the Accounting and Travel & E-commerce channels across France and Spain. The broader scope includes Payments and Venture Capital and may evolve with business priorities.

The role is based in either France or Spain, with a minimum of three days per week in the relevant Airwallex office.

What you’ll do...

  • Own the France and Spain partnerships strategy, aligned with the SME & Growth GTM.

  • Set partner ICPs, commercial priorities, account plans, pipeline expectations and operating standards across the team.

  • Lead, coach and develop the four partnership managers.

  • Personally source and progress a portfolio of strategic partnerships in at least one priority vertical.

  • Build repeatable referral, reseller, co-selling and partner-led outbound motions across Accounting, Travel, Payments, E-commerce and VC.

  • Ensure signed partnerships become active commercial channels, not passive logos.

  • Work with Sales on account mapping, lead routing, qualification, follow-up and conversion of partner-sourced opportunities.

  • Track active partners, referrals, opportunities, sourced and influenced pipeline, conversion, time to first referral and revenue contribution.

  • Test partner segments and commercial motions; scale what creates quality pipeline and stop what does not.

  • Work cross-functionally with Marketing, RevOps, Product, Solutions, Risk and Compliance to remove friction from the partner journey.

What you’ll bring...

  • 8+ years in partnerships, channel sales, indirect sales, partner sales, strategic business development or a comparable commercial role.

  • A successful 0-to-1 partnership motion or vertical launch in Accounting or Travel & E-commerce, with measurable commercial outcomes.

  • Strong channel-led execution and a personal track record of partner-sourced referrals, pipeline, opportunities or revenue.

  • Commercial experience across at least two of these verticals: Accounting, Travel, Payments, E-commerce or Venture Capital.

  • A deep, activatable network in at least one priority vertical, with access to senior decision-makers.

  • Strong strategic judgement and hands-on execution: you can define the strategy and personally open the first doors, lead key meetings and progress strategic partnerships.

  • Experience designing partner ICPs, activation motions, attribution and channel performance management.

  • Experience leading, coaching or developing partnership professionals is preferred. Formal people-management experience is valuable, but not the only indicator of leadership potential.

  • Experience in accounting, payments, fintech, ERP, financial software or another competitive B2B environment.

  • Professional English plus native or bilingual French or Spanish. Native or bilingual proficiency in the other local language is a strong advantage, but not required.

  • Comfortable with CRM, funnel metrics, partner economics and basic business cases.

Who you are...

  • Strategic and hands-on: you can set direction while staying close to partners, pipeline and commercial details.

  • Channel-led: you care about net-new business and revenue, not only signed agreements or ecosystem visibility.

  • A builder: you create structure from zero, test quickly and learn without waiting for a perfect playbook.

  • Commercially accountable: you use data to decide where to invest, coach or stop.

  • A player-coach: you develop people while continuing to win strategic partnerships yourself.

What success looks like...

  • The four partnership managers have clear mandates, partner ICPs, account priorities and measurable pipeline objectives.

  • Accounting and Travel & E-commerce have prioritised partner strategies and active channel motions in France and Spain.

  • Partner cohorts are recruited, activated and connected to repeatable referral, reseller or co-selling motions.

⭐️ The mission of the Union Relations Lead

Unions and social partners play a central and legitimate role in how social protection is designed, negotiated and implemented in France. We're looking for a Union Relations Lead to build and animate Alan's relationships with unions, their federations, and the broader paritariste ecosystem, making Alan a trusted, substantive and well-known interlocutor of French social partners, and supporting our Enterprise & Public Sector teams across large private employers and public institutions.


⭐ What makes this role genuinely unique

  • You'll shape how one of Europe's fastest-growing health tech companies builds its relationships with the French social partner ecosystem (from confederations to sector federations to paritariste institutions).

  • You'll operate at the highest levels of the paritariste ecosystem: CFDT and FO confederal leadership, sector federations, IP boards, organisations patronales.

  • You'll shape the strategy, not just execute it. Alan is at an early stage of building this capability (the playbook is yours to define)

  • You'll work directly with Founders, Public Affair as well as Public Sector and Enterprise leadership.

  • Real ownership from day one, in one of the fastest-growing tech unicorns in Europe.

⭐️ Your role

Relationships & Presence

  • Build and maintain trusted, long-term relationships with the organizations that represent employees and members across the sectors that matter to Alan (unions, federations, and the structures that convene them).

  • Map the ecosystem, prioritize interlocutors, and design the engagement strategy at confederal, federal and branch level.

  • Represent Alan in federations, working groups, congrès and paritariste institutions where our sector’s future is discussed.

  • Be the credible consistent Alan voice social partners recognise

Partnership with Alan's Enterprise & Public Sector work

  • Be a partner to our teams serving large private employers and public sector clients, briefing them on the social partners context and how Alan’s offer speaks to their priorities

  • Introduce the right contacts at the right moment in the commercial cycle, turning Alan’s ecosystem relationships into concrete commercial leverage.

  • Share Alan’s content with social partners to help them assess Alan on its merits and form their own view.

Sector Engagement & Anticipation

  • Follow the dialogue at branch level and across the paritariste ecosystem and turn that understanding into internal clarity.

  • Represent Alan in the federations and working groups where our sector's future is discussed, contributing a constructive and recognizable voice.

Alan operates at the intersection of health insurance, prevention, and regulated data. The person in this role owns the security governance and risk posture of a company that handles sensitive health data for 1M+ members, operates under DORA and HDS certification requirements, and is regulated by the ACPR. They work in close partnership with Legal, Internal Audit, and the broader Risk function. It's a highly collaborative role.

🛡️ Your mission: Governance, risk & compliance

Own and operate the ISO 27001 ISMS. You are the accountable owner of the Information Security Management System: scope definition, Statement of Applicability, internal audit programme, and management review. You've led at least one full certification or recertification cycle and know what breaks down in the months between audits.

Be the security expert on regulatory and privacy matters. Legal leads on DORA, HDS, RGPD, PGSSI-S, and regulatory relationships. Your role is to bring the technical and operational security substance: translating regulatory requirements into controls, flagging implementation gaps, and making sure the security programme is solid when the regulatory team negotiates with the ACPR or ANS.

Run risk as an ongoing programme, in partnership with the broader risk function. You lead security risk cartography using EBIOS RM and ensure it feeds into, and is informed by, the company-wide risk framework. You facilitate risk workshops, produce treatment plans, and bring the security lens to forums where non-security risks are also on the table. You know when a security risk is really a business risk.

Own the controls framework, but distribute ownership of controls themselves. You define the framework, set the standards, and track coverage, but the controls live with the teams who build and run the things they protect. You work closely with Infrastructure, Platform, and Engineering to ensure foundational building blocks (identity, network, secrets management, logging) are designed with security requirements built in from the start. You work alongside those teams as a partner.

Run audit cycles with rigour, in close partnership with Internal Audit. You manage the security audit programme and coordinate with certification bodies. You work with Internal Audit to align scopes, avoid duplication, and present a coherent picture of control effectiveness to the board. You've sat in joint audit planning sessions and know how to make that relationship work well.

Manage third-party risk. You run vendor security assessments and define contractual security requirements (security annexes, DPAs). You partner with our Risk team, which oversees third-party risk, and own the security dimension.

Bring the health sector context. You understand the ANS framework, CERT Santé requirements, and what it means to handle sensitive health data in day-to-day operations. You're a useful partner to Legal when the question is "what does this regulation actually require us to do technically?"

Own incident governance and support DORA reporting. You classify and escalate ICT incidents internally, own BCP and DRP governance, and provide the security substance for DORA incident reports.

🚀 What you'll build and who you'll work with

Compliance Framework: ISO 27001, DORA, HDS, NIS2. Multiple regulators, multiple countries, one coherent governance backbone. Build the system that lets Alan scale from 1M to many millions of members without rebuilding compliance every time.

Automated Audit & Evidence Engine: Replace manual evidence collection with scripted pipelines plugged directly into engineering systems. Turn audit cycles into a continuous capability instead of a quarterly rush.

Risk Cartography: Risk treated as an operational signal that feeds directly into business and engineering decisions, with EBIOS RM at the core.

You'll work closely with Legal, DPO, Internal Audit, and the broader Risk function, and partner day-to-day with Infrastructure, Platform, Engineering, Product, and Operations. You're the bridge between regulatory complexity and operational simplicity.

⚡ Why this role is special

Direct Impact: You own the trust foundation that lets Alan handle health data for 1M+ members and operate in highly regulated markets. Your work is the precondition for everything else Alan does.

Complex Problems: 4 regulators across 4 countries, sensitive health data, and a regulatory landscape that keeps shifting (DORA, NIS2, AI Act), all to be modeled into a single, coherent control system.

Ownership & Growth: Board and executive exposure, real influence on company-wide risk decisions, and the autonomy to shape Alan's security culture across 800+ people.

🤝 What you will also do: Technical enablement

Automate compliance work wherever possible. You script evidence collection, automate control testing, and connect GRC tooling to engineering pipelines. You've used Python or similar to reduce the manual work of an audit cycle, and you actively look for the next process to streamline.

Configure and own GRC tooling. You can administer platforms like CISO Assistant, ServiceNow GRC, or Archer, designing workflows, building dashboards, and making them genuinely useful for the teams that feed them data.

Speak cloud governance fluently. You understand shared responsibility in HDS-qualified environments, know what CSPM tools surface and what they miss, and can reason about policy-as-code (OPA, SCP) without needing an engineer to translate.

Read architecture well enough to challenge it. You can review a proposed architecture, identify control gaps in identity, network segmentation, encryption, or logging, and push back credibly with engineers even though you're not one.

Interpret vulnerability data and drive prioritisation. You read scan outputs, work with engineering teams to prioritise remediation by business impact over CVSS score alone, and track resolution KPIs over time.

⭐️ Qualifications, mindset and soft skills

About Vibe

Streaming TV is no longer just a brand awareness channel. It’s becoming a core part of the performance marketing mix, alongside search and social. Vibe.co is building the platform that makes TV work like the rest of the acquisition stack: targeted, measurable, and optimized for results.


Vibe.co is an Audience First Streaming TV Advertising platform that gives marketers the tools to reach the right audiences, optimize campaigns in real time, and understand what’s actually driving business outcomes. Today, more than 12,000 brands use Vibe.co to reach 120 million+ households. And in August 2026, Vibe.co became a Walmart company, opening up a new chapter for the business and the industry. With Walmart’s first-party data and purchase signals now part of the Vibe platform, advertisers can connect TV advertising to real-world transactions and measure the impact of CTV with a level of precision previously associated with platforms like Google and Meta.


This is a unique moment to join Vibe. With Walmart’s scale, data, and reach behind us, we’re building the next generation of TV advertising and creating a more measurable, performance-driven future for the channel.

About the Role

You'll join People Ops, the Systems and Operations pillar of the People team. It owns payroll, HRIS, onboarding and offboarding, contracts, benefits, and compliance across France, the US, and our remote geographies. You'll report to Melissa, our Senior Global HR Systems and Operations Manager in Paris. We're opening this role because Vibe is scaling fast across regions, and payroll plus People Ops now need a dedicated owner who keeps the engine running and makes it better. If you want real ownership of payroll from day one, a front-row seat to how an international team actually operates across three geographies, and the room to reshape and automate the work as you go, this is the seat.

What You'll Do

Payroll and contractors

  • Run the monthly French payroll cycle with our external provider, from variable inputs to final validation.

  • Check every payslip before sign-off to catch errors before they reach employees.

  • Keep EOR payroll on schedule across our remote geographies.

  • Own contractor operations end to end, from timesheet collection to the Finance provisioning file.

  • Reconcile each cycle to catch what doesn't add up before it’s live.

People operations and HR admin

  • Manage employment documents for a team spread across France, the US, and remote.

  • Administer benefits: enrollments, changes, and the questions employees bring.

  • Run onboarding and offboarding logistics so every joiner and leaver lands cleanly.

Employee support

  • Serve as first point of contact for employees on People questions.

  • Triage incoming requests through our ticketing system against agreed SLAs.

  • Research individual employee cases across policy, contracts, and local labour law.

Systems and projects

  • Maintain HRIS data hygiene and the workflows behind it.

  • Drive People Ops projects end to end, with clear scope, deadlines, and stakeholders.

What You Need

  • 3+ years in payroll, HR administration, or People Ops. An apprenticeship or internship counts.

  • Strong knowledge of French payroll and labour law fundamentals: contracts, absences, final pay, health and provident cover.

  • Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills and real comfort working with numbers.

  • Project management basics: you've run something with a real deadline and a scope that moved.

  • Experience with an HRIS.

  • Fluent French and English. English is our working language.

Nice to Haves

  • Hands-on experience in a ticketing tool.

  • Exposure to international or EOR payroll.

  • Comfort building automations to cut manual work.

title: Technology Transformation - Senior
description:
Eight Advisory est un cabinet leader sur le marché du conseil financier et opérationnel, indépendant, spécialisé en Transaction, Restructuration et Transformation d’entreprises.

Nous accompagnons les dirigeants, les actionnaires, les banques et les investisseurs potentiels dans leurs décisions.

En rejoignant notre équipe Transformation IT, vous interviendrez principalement dans les contextes suivants :

  • Accompagnement des opérations M&A :

    • Dans un contexte de transaction, vous participerez aux « IT Due Diligences » dans lesquels vous présenterez un état des lieux de l’entreprise d’un point de vue IT : organisation de la DSI, stratégie et projets, infrastructure, applications, analyses des dépenses IT.

    • Dans un contexte de détourage d’actifs

      • Vous réaliserez une « IT Due Diligence » de ou des entités concernées en insistant sur les enjeux de dépendance et d’adhérence vis-à-vis du groupe / du vendeur ;

      • Vous évaluerez les éléments IT ayant un impact sur la valeur des actifs ;

      • Vous participerez à l’élaboration de plan de séparation et à la rédaction des TSA.

    • Dans un contexte d’intégration

      • Vous définirez la stratégie d’intégration de l’entité cible, la recherche de synergies, la définition et la déclinaison opérationnelle de projets d’intégration, l’optimisation des coûts et du planning d’intégration ;

      • Vous challengerez les propositions d’intégration d’éventuels prestataires.

      • Vous participerez au suivi des différents chantiers d’intégration.

  • Conduite de la transformation IT & Digitale :

    • Vous participerez à la définition de plans de transformation IT et digitale, visant à soutenir la stratégie de développement ou de reconstruction de l’entreprise ;

    • Vous travaillerez à l’élaboration de schémas directeurs : planning, coûts, ressources, priorisation des projets, etc. ;

    • Vous pourrez suivre et piloter les différents chantiers de ce schéma directeur pour en assurer le bon déroulement.


  • Pilotage et amélioration de la performance :

    • Vous assisterez nos clients dans l’amélioration et le contrôle de leur performance IT, en particulier à l’audit de projets IT et à la revue de la performance de la DSI ;

    • Vous accompagnerez nos clients dans la rédaction de cahier des charges, en les assistant dans le choix des outils répondant à leurs besoins ;

    • Vous participerez à la définition et mise en œuvre de plan d’actions impactant l’EBITDA et/ou la trésorerie (réduction des coûts IT, réorganisation de la DSI, optimisation des projets, etc.) ;

    • Dans le cadre d’un accompagnement de nos clients en situation de perte de rentabilité, manque de visibilité ou de compréhension des flux de la part des managers (actionnaires ou société mère), vous participerez à la réalisation de diagnostics mêlant finance & IT, à l’accompagnement à la renégociation de contrats, à l’élaboration de plans d’amélioration de la rentabilité et de rationalisation de la DSI, puis à la mise en œuvre opérationnelle.


Nous recherchons pour ces missions des candidats de formation supérieure (Bac+5 –école d’ingénieur ou école de commerce de rang A), ayant acquis une expérience probante parmi les suivantes :

  • Une expérience dans le conseil durant laquelle il/elle aura développé de solides compétences IT & digitales avec une appétence pour l’analyse des impacts financiers attendus.

  • Une expérience opérationnelle dans une structure reconnue pour son excellence dans les domaines informatiques et / ou digitaux.

  • Une bonne connaissances des outils présents sur le marché.

Vous êtes dotés de qualités relationnelles et analytiques reconnues. Curieux, dynamique, vous faites preuve d'esprit d'équipe et vous pratiquez couramment l’anglais dans le cadre de vos missions (la pratique d’une seconde langue étrangère sera un plus). Vous êtes motivé par le challenge d’intervenir dans des contextes à fort enjeux stratégiques marqués par des opérations de haut de bilan et/ou de retournement et d’élargir vos compétences sur les dimensions IT, financières et opérationnelles.
